purpose: Acquire row-complete or explicitly coverage-bounded external event manifests before any new STARLIKE/POSS-I temporal association is inspected.

priority_sources.coverage_rule: File presence and row density do not prove continuous solar observing coverage. A later parser must model/report observatory coverage or restrict inference to independently documented observable/reporting opportunity.
priority_sources.zero_rule: No report row on a calendar day MUST NOT be treated as physical zero flare activity until coverage semantics are established.

priority_sources.admission_requirement: Row-complete dated manifest over a declared site/program interval. Famous launch dates alone are context-only.
Explicit program date coverage and launch/test rows. Missing archival records may not be interpreted as no balloon activity.
Bind station identifier, coordinates, station lineage, variable coverage and missingness before joining to Palomar nights.

priority_sources.authority: IAU Meteor Data Center established showers
priority_sources.admission_requirement: Freeze shower identity and solar-longitude peak/range; compute historical solar longitude deterministically before outcome inspection.

acquisition_order: Freeze NOAA/NCEI H-alpha source bytes and SHA-256 manifests.
Inspect only source schema/coverage metadata, not STARLIKE/POSS outcome overlap.
Define a versioned flare event-consolidation rule that prevents multiple station reports of one solar flare becoming multiple independent events.
Freeze flare severity/timing endpoints before association testing.
Acquire human-made launch/balloon and Palomar weather manifests with explicit completeness gates.
Only then create a separate JPFM-3C association preregistration.
forbidden_before_next_preregistration: Selecting flare intensity thresholds because they maximize STARLIKE/POSS coincidence.
Treating missing H-alpha reports as zero flare activity.
Using a hand-curated list of famous rockets or balloons as a negative-control denominator.
Adding or dropping event classes after inspecting correlation outcomes.
Promoting temporal coincidence to common physical-object identity or causal origin.
